action.sql: SELECT g.entity_id, e.currency, SUM(g.credit - g.debit) AS revenue FROM gl_lines g JOIN accounts a ON g.account_id = a.account_id JOIN entities e ON g.entity_id = e.entity_id WHERE a.type = 'Revenue' AND g.period IN ('2026-01', '2026-02', '2026-03') AND g.entity_id IN ('CA01', 'US01') GROUP BY g.entity_id, e.currency ORDER BY g.entity_id
